items.text: John Harbaugh named J.J. McCarthy the starter over Jameis Winston; Jaxson Dart is on IR.

Giants LB Tremaine Edmunds (shoulder) and CB Greg Newsome II (concussion) did not practice Wednesday or Thursday; LT Andrew Thomas, RT Jermaine Eluemunor and S Jevon Holland were upgraded to limited Thursday.

Houston RB David Montgomery (groin), S Reed Blankenship (concussion), S Jalen Pitre (shoulder) and OT Blake Fisher (thumb) did not practice Wednesday or Thursday; TE Dalton Schultz and LB Azeez Al-Shaair limited Thursday. WR Jayden Higgins is out for the season; C.J. Stroud is not on the report.

adjust.reason: Houston has missed both starting safeties, RB David Montgomery and a starting tackle at practice all week while the Giants' linemen are trending back. The stats model doesn't price non-QB injuries
